STYLE: High-detail Japanese anime-style 2.5D character illustration. A bright, adorable adult anime face drawn to her own FACE line below — her own eye size and shape, nose, mouth and jaw, not one shared default face; delicately drawn eyelids. Fine subtle linework, smooth skin shading and softly blended gradients. Layered flowing hair with carefully drawn strands and delicate highlights. Highly detailed clothing and accessories with convincing fabric weave, stitching, folds, seams, buckles and material-specific reflections. Apply this style only to the person, preserving the separately specified character design, pose and setting.

OUTPUT: one standalone off-duty scene of her in the outfit chosen in SCENE; her species shows only through accessories and objects around her — never in the outfit's colours, patterns or cut, never armor, never a creature costume. Everything else follows SCENE (chosen).

SCENE (chosen):
Place: a quiet hotel breakfast terrace after an adult cabaret rehearsal, a shaded wicker daybed and a bowl of nectarines, soft late-morning daylight.
Activity and situation: still sleepy after the rehearsal, she takes a long unhurried seated stretch while letting the morning warmth reach her shoulders. This deliberate resting stretch lengthens her exposed waist naturally; her costume stays fully fastened and opaque.
Pose and composition: seated sideways on the daybed with one knee raised loosely and the other leg stretched along its cushion, upper body turned gently toward camera. Her right forearm extends forward with the palm resting lightly on the raised knee; her left hand rests on the cushion beside her left hip, both arms entirely in front of or beside her body. Camera at seated eye level, a head-to-below-knees portrait with her full face readable.
Outfit: a fashion cabaret event costume in burnt orange and cream, an opaque sculptural fan-fold bustier with a broad curved lower edge and a fitted split-front petal skort anchored at the high waist; small covered side ties, no stockings, no outer layer. Bare shoulders, midriff and thighs; chest and pelvis securely covered. Her black pearl earring and a small spiral clasp on her travel pouch echo her motif, with no armor.
EXPRESSION: heavy drooping eyelids, soft unfocused eyes, softened slack mouth, brow low and relaxed. Show it mildly, only with her brows, eyelids and mouth corners; her face shape and features stay exactly as in the attached image.

Do not carry the attached image's palette, patterns or trim into the outfit; her source belongs in accessories and props, never in the clothes — never restyle the chosen outfit into her own costume, genre or palette.

Do not copy its head angle, head tilt, gaze direction, face size in frame, camera height or crop — turn her head, set her gaze and place the camera as SCENE describes, and let her face read naturally from that new angle (profile, three-quarter, looking down or away), with her features staying the same.

ONE MAIN FIGURE: she is the only character in focus; where the place is busy, a few background people may share the scene — same ground, light and style, sized for their distance, busy with their own activity, never facing the camera or posing beside her; quiet or private places stay empty.
